title: Soča at Log Čezsoški, 2 September 1984, 37 cm

stages.name: the river turned off: the bed round the rock, falling into the scour
the boulder in body colour, turned to the sun
shadows: the rock's on the bed, the trout's beside it on the rock
the sun through the swell: bands on the rock's back, a net in the deep
the trout, eight centimetres down, over the rock's shoulder
the river back in over it
the skin: glassy, the riffle coming in at the top
